Feature

A monthly that reads slower on purpose

Revue Lumière had grown loud: six typefaces, a cover line on every inch. We cut it to two faces, one cover image and a grid of nine columns that lets long reads run wide and short ones sit quietly in the margin.

Newsstand sales rose for the first time in a decade; the letters page asked us to never change it again.
